digest.en: Europe & Russia leads the board this hour with Ukraine’s Newest Battlefields: Online Retailers, Gas Stations, Shadow Fleets. Middle East & Africa carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर एशिया-प्रशांत की अगुवाई है, तबाह होने वाला है टोक्यो! खौफ में जापान बना रहा दूसरी राजधानी? रेस में 4 शहरों का नाम मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही मध्य पूर्व और अफ्रीका से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Ukraine’s Newest Battlefields: Online Retailers, Gas Stations, Shadow Fleets
articles.summary: Why is Ukraine pounding the warehouses and logistics centers of the company known as Russia’s Amazon? For the same reason it’s trying to drive Russian car owners crazy by forcing them to wait in crazy long lines at fueling stations. Ukraine’s Newest Battlefields: Online Retailers, Gas Stations, Shadow Fleets.

articles.title: Does Iran's Attack On Jordan Mark A Shift In Military Strategy?
articles.summary: In what appeared to be the first time Tehran initiated an attack against US targets since the war in the Persian Gulf began in late February, Iran fired ballistic missiles at American bases in Jordan late on July 28. Does Iran's Attack On Jordan Mark A Shift In Military Strategy?

articles.title: From Pajero culture to street protests: The struggle for accountability in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir
articles.summary: For decades, the Pakistani state has diplomatically showcased PoK to the world as if it were a separate country, complete with its own constitution, a Prime Minister as chief executive, and a President as constitutional head From Pajero culture to street protests: The struggle for accountability in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir.

articles.title: Ukraine says it hit a major Russian oil refinery, hours after Zelenskyy’s meeting with Trump
articles.summary: The overnight attack started a fire at the Ryazan refinery, which has a capacity of about 17 million tonnes of oil per year, producing gasoline, diesel fuel, aviation fuel and other petroleum products, according to Ukraine’s General Staff Ukraine says it hit a major Russian oil refinery, hours after Zelenskyy’s meeting with Trump.

articles.title: Hunger hampers Ebola response as cases top 3,200 in DR Congo
articles.summary: The UN emergency food agency appealed for immediate funding on Wednesday, warning that deepening hunger is undermining the response to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) that has now infected more than 3,200 people. Hunger hampers Ebola response as cases top 3,200 in DR Congo.

articles.title: UN warns West Bank settler violence hits ‘all-time high’ as calls grow to end occupation
articles.summary: Violence in the occupied West Bank is worsening as the Israeli Government continues to approve new settlements, while settlers and Israeli security forces have “often” acted together to attack local Palestinian communities, the UN’s human rights office (OHCHR) warned on Wednesday. UN warns West Bank settler violence hits ‘all-time high’ as calls grow to end occupation'. Violence in the occupied West Bank is worsening as the Israeli Government continues to approve new settlements while settlers and Israeli security forces have “often” acted together to attack local Palestinian communities, the UN’s human rights office (OHCHR) warned on Wednesday.

articles.title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Targets Deep Inside Russia, Wildberries Hit Again
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck targets in several places inside Russia on July 29, including an oil refinery and a logistics center belonging to Russia's largest online retailer, Wildberries, as Kyiv expands its long-range strike campaign to pressure Moscow into peace negotiations. Ukrainian Drones Strike Targets Deep Inside Russia, Wildberries Hit Again.

articles.title: Ukraine Hits Another Wildberries Warehouse In Russia
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck a Wildberries warehouse in the Ryazan region, Russia, setting the building on fire. Wildberries confirmed the evacuation of the facility, marking another hit in a string of drone attacks on Russian industrial sites. Ukrainian drones struck industrial facilities in Russia's Ryazan region, with videos on social media showing a Wildberries warehouse engulfed in flames. Russia's largest online retailer said it evacuated the facility.

articles.title: Asia’s central banks are quietly writing the rules for AI finance
articles.summary: The global economy is entering a new era in which artificial intelligence is no longer merely a technological innovation but an increasingly influential economic force. Much as the internet transformed commerce and globalization reshaped production networks, AI is beginning to alter how businesses make decisions, how capital is allocated, and how financial systems operate. What [] The post Asia’s Asia’s central banks are quietly writing the rules for AI finance.

articles.title: Stories of survival and loss emerge after Japan earthquake
articles.summary: Rescuers pulling people from the wreckage in southern Japan in a haunting repeat of disaster that struck 10 years agoJapan earthquake – latest updates‘Race against time’: Japan earthquake death toll rises as rescue teams search for missing“There was a voice coming from the collapsed house, and I could see a hand,” Tomohide Nagata, a volunteer firefighter, told the Kumamoto Nichinichi Shimbun.

articles.title: For Central Asian Migrants, Russia's School Rules Are Splitting Families
articles.summary: As the new school year approaches, Central Asian migrant parents face a stark choice: bring their children to Russia and risk them being unable to enroll because of stricter Russian language rules or leave them behind. For Central Asian Migrants, Russia's School Rules Are Splitting Families.

articles.title: Japan earthquake death toll rises as rescue teams search for missing
articles.summary: Military mobilises thousands of personnel after quake on southern Kyushu island that registered a maximum 7 on the Japanese shindo intensity scale At least five people have been killed, and nine are missing after a 6.8 magnitude earthquake struck southern Japan on Tuesday, injuring hundreds and knocking out power and water to tens of thousands. Military mobilises thousands of personnel after quake on southern Kyushu island that registered a maximum 7 on the Japanese shindo intensity scale At least 13 people were killed when a 6.8 magnitude earthquake struck southern Japan on Tuesday, injuring hundreds and knocking out power and water to tens of thousands.“There are people who are still waiting to be rescued, and it’s a race against time,.

articles.title: Remember the two-state solution? Trump doesn’t
articles.summary: Israel’s right-wing government is intensifying its half-century-long campaign to take over the West Bank fully by unleashing bands of settler militias to harass Palestinian residents, destroy their homes and livelihoods and restrict their movement throughout the occupied territory. The aim is to quickly erase conditions necessary for creating a viable Palestinian state alongside Israel, a [] The Remember the two-state solution?

articles.title: Bank Indonesia drama shows why rupiah is plunging
articles.summary: TOKYO. Investors hoping President Prabowo Subianto might learn from Indonesia’s past economic mistakes should get used to disappointment. Since taking office in October 2024, Prabowo has worked to drag Southeast Asia’s biggest economy back into its past. Which past is debatable. What isn’t debatable: the general-turned-politician is overseeing Indonesia’s worst financial turmoil since the [] The Bank Indonesia drama shows why rupiah is plunging.

articles.title: US bans humanoid robots from China, citing ‘unacceptable risks’
articles.summary: Move comes as the Trump administration has increasingly sought to keep Chinese technology out of the USThe Federal Communications Commission announced a ban on humanoid robots from China on Tuesday, saying that the technology poses “unacceptable risks” to the country’s national security. The move comes as the Trump administration has increasingly sought to keep Chinese technology out of the US.

articles.title: Russia Sanctions Bill Shows 'Bipartisan Coalition Of Support' For Ukraine
articles.summary: Ahead of a Senate vote on a sanctions package targeting Russia and Iran, Democratic Senator Sheldon Whitehouse, a co-sponsor of the legislation, told RFE/RL that the legislation sends a strong message that the United States is committed to supporting Ukraine. Russia Sanctions Bill Shows 'Bipartisan Coalition Of Support' For Ukraine.

articles.title: Russia-Iran Sanctions Bill Signals Congress United Behind Ukraine, Senator Whitehouse Tells RFE/RL
articles.summary: As the US Senate prepared to vote on a sweeping bipartisan sanctions package targeting Russia and Iran, Democratic Senator Sheldon Whitehouse, a co-sponsor of the legislation, said the measure reflects renewed bipartisan resolve to squeeze the Kremlin war machine and reinforce support for Ukraine. Russia-Iran Sanctions Bill Signals Congress United Behind Ukraine, Senator Whitehouse Tells RFE/RL.

articles.title: Ukraine Hits At Iran. In The Caspian Sea, Things Get Even Messier.
articles.summary: Russia’s Iranian-designed drones have ravaged Ukrainian forces in Moscow’s all-out war. As far as Ukraine is concerned, that means cargo ships plying the Caspian Sea with Iranian military goods are fair game. Including this past weekend. Ukraine Hits At Iran In The Caspian Sea. And Things Get Even Messier. In The Caspian Sea, Things Get Even Messier.

articles.title: Mount Olympus and D-Day beaches among new World Heritage Sites
articles.summary: From the peaks of Mount Olympus in Greece to the shores of the “D-Day” beaches in France, 25 cultural or natural landmarks from across the globe have been newly inscribed on the World Heritage List, updated annually by the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO). Mount Olympus and D-Day beaches among new World Heritage Sites.

articles.title: HIV, hepatitis, STI gains at risk as funding falls, WHO warns
articles.summary: Years of progress in tackling HIV, viral hepatitis and sexually transmitted infections (STIs) are at risk of stalling, leaving millions of people without access to life-saving prevention, testing and treatment, the World Health Organization (WHO) has warned. HIV, hepatitis, STI gains at risk as funding falls, WHO warns.

articles.title: IOM warns trafficking networks are booming
articles.summary: A job advert can hide a criminal network, and a single click can lead to a nightmare. Hundreds of thousands of people are trafficked every year on the promise of legitimate work abroad, only to be held captive and forced into online scam operations. IOM warns trafficking networks are booming.

articles.title: Updates on Gaza, West Bank amid regional tensions
articles.summary: Regional tensions are mounting as the US-Iran war continues and a rising number of Israeli attacks are threatening Gaza’s fragile October ceasefire that ended two years of war with Hamas. Security Council members are hearing updates on Tuesday. Join our live coverage. Updates on Gaza, West Bank amid regional tensions. Security Council members heard briefings followed by an open debate on Tuesday.

articles.title: Javier Milei accuses US Democrats of financing ‘anti-Argentina campaign’ at World Cup
articles.summary: President also blames Brazil and Mexico and says online critics ‘do not want the ideas of freedom to succeed’More than a week has passed since Ferran Torres scored the extra-time goal that gave Spain its second World Cup, but – at least for Argentina’s president – the tournament is not over. Javier Milei accuses US Democrats of financing ‘anti-Argentina campaign’ at World Cup.

articles.title: Canada’s GCAP fighter move tests limits of US diversification
articles.summary: Canada’s entry into the Global Combat Air Program (GCAP) highlights a broader strategic dilemma: how to modernize its air force without deepening dependence on any single supplier or undermining the interoperability on which its defense commitments rely. This month, multiple media outlets reported that Canada officially joined the GCAP as its first observer nation, marking [] The post Canada’s GC.

articles.title: Vietnam’s smart-port push opens another door to Washington
articles.summary: Vietnam’s effort to modernize Da Nang’s maritime infrastructure may look at first like another Asian port-development project, but it is considerably more important than that. The transformation underway along Vietnam’s central coast brings together three priorities that increasingly define Hanoi’s foreign policy: economic modernization, technological self-reliance and stronger maritime awareness Vietnam’s smart-port push opens another door to Washington.

articles.title: तबाह होने वाला है टोक्यो! खौफ में जापान बना रहा दूसरी राजधानी? रेस में 4 शहरों का नाम
articles.summary: जापानी संसद ने देश की एक 'दूसरी राजधानी' बनाने के ऐतिहासिक कानून को मंजूरी दे दी है. वैज्ञानिकों और ब्लूमबर्ग की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक अगले 30 सालों में टोक्यो में भयानक जलजला आने वाला है. जिसके बाद पूरा देश ठप्प पड़ जाएगा. इसी तबाही से निपटने के लिए ताकाइची सरकार ने मास्टरप्लान तैयार किया है. जापानी सरकार की बैकअप राजधानी की रेस में ओसाका, नागोया, फुकुओका और सपोरो जैसे शहर सबसे आगे हैं.

articles.title: जब एक मां ने ही दूसरे के बच्चे को मारकर खा लिया, लाइव कैमरे में कैद हुई हैवानियत
articles.summary: अलास्का के कटमई नेशनल पार्क से एक बेहद खौफनाक घटना सामने आई है. यहां के मशहूर लाइव कैमरे में एक मादा भालू की क्रूरता कैद हुई है. 806 नंबर की इस भालू ने एक दूसरे भालू के छोटे बच्चे को बेरहमी से मार डाला. हैरानी की बात यह है कि उसने उस बच्चे को अपना निवाला भी बना लिया. यह घटना ब्रूक्स रिवर के पास हुई है.

articles.summary: PoK में अपने ही नागरिकों पर पाकिस्तानी सेना की बर्बरता और मानवाधिकारों के खुले उल्लंघन पर वेस्टर्न मीडिया चुप है. जबकि संयुक्त राष्ट्र और एम्नेस्टी इंटरनेशनल जैसी अंतरराष्ट्रीय संस्थाओं ने चिंता जताई है. इस मानवीय संकट के बीच बीबीसी, सीएनएन और फॉक्स न्यूज जैसे दिग्गज पश्चिमी मीडिया घरानों की खामोशी ने उनके दोहरे मापदंड को पूरी तरह बेनकाब कर दिया है.

articles.title: 'किसी को नहीं बख्शेंगे...', पेपर लीक बिल पास होने पर अमित शाह का पहला रिएक्शन
articles.summary: लोकसभा से एंटी पेपर लीक संसोधन बिल पास होने पर केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने भारत के छात्रों को बधाई दी है. उन्होंने कहा कि इस बिल में ऐसे कई कड़े प्रावधान हैं जो युवाओं को सपनों की रक्षा करेगा. एक्स पर पोस्ट कर गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने लिखा, 'यह विधेयक सार्वजनिक परीक्षाओं की पवित्रता को भंग करने की हिम्मत करने वालों के लिए सबसे कठोर सजा के कड़े प्रावधान करके हमारे युवाओं के सपनों और आकांक्षाओं की।

articles.title: 'अगर पुराना कानून सफल था तो..', महुआ मोइत्रा ने सरकार को घेरा
articles.summary: लोकसभा में एंटी-पेपर लीक (संशोधन) बिल 2026 को पास किए जाने के बाद तृणमूल कांग्रेस (TMC) सांसद महुआ मोइत्रा ने सरकार पर तीखा हमला बोला. उन्होंने कहा कि यह स्थिति अपने आप में एक मजाक जैसी है क्योंकि इसी सदन ने वर्ष 2024 में भी इसी विषय से जुड़ा कानून पारित किया था, लेकिन वह प्रभावी साबित नहीं हुआ. उनके अनुसार, यदि 2024 का कानून सही तरीके से काम करता तो सरकार को 2026 में फिर से संशोधन लाने की जरूरत न।

articles.title: 'मैं सही समय...', सदन में भाषण पूरा न होने पर राहुल का रिएक्शन
articles.summary: राहुल गांधी ने सदन में अपना भाषण पूरा नहीं कर पाने के बाद कहा, "मैं सही समय पर बोलता हूं." इसके बाद, प्रियंका गांधी ने कहा कि पूरा देश देख रहा है कि क्या हुआ और बच्चे की आंख फोड़ दी गई है. राहुल गांधी ने एक्स पर भी पोस्ट किया और कहा कि उन्होंने सदन में अपने भाषण को पूरा करने का प्रयास किया था.

articles.title: राहुल गांधी के 'दो बोल' से बवाल! जानें सदन के अंदर और बाहर का हाल?
articles.summary: लोकसभा में नेता प्रतिपक्ष राहुल गांधी ने एक छात्रा के हवाले से कहा कि वह 'इडियट' को भगवान मानने वालों को 'अंधभक्त' मानती है. बीजेपी सांसदों ने इस पर जमकर हंगामा किया और स्पीकर ओम बिरला ने 'इडियट' शब्द को असंसदीय करार दिया. इस घटना के बाद सदन में भूचाल आ गया और विपक्ष और सत्तापक्ष के बीच जमकर तकरार हो रही है.

articles.summary: चीन का स्वदेशी यात्री विमान C919 अब केवल सामान्य उड़ानों तक सीमित नहीं है, बल्कि उसने तिब्बत के ल्हासा जैसे दुर्गम इलाकों में सफल परीक्षण कर दुनिया को चौंका दिया है. दिखने में भले ही ये एयरबस और बोइंग की मोनोपोली को चुनौती देने वाला एक कमर्शियल प्लेन लगे, लेकिन रक्षा विशेषज्ञों के अनुसार ये भारत के लिए वास्तविक नियंत्रण रेखा (LAC) पर एक बड़ा सीक्रेट खतरा बन सकता है.
